"""Scale checks: many leases, large outputs, repeated targets."""
import sys, time, json, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from harness import *

ok = True
S = {'a': 'tcp', 'b': 'adb', 'c': 'sync'}
N = 2048
leases = [lease('L%04d' % i, '2001:db8:%04x::/56' % i, 0, 10 ** 12, [0], 1) for i in range(N)]
rows = []
for i, L in enumerate(leases):
    base = int(ipaddress.IPv6Network(L['prefix']).network_address)
    t = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base + 1))
    rows.append(icmp('p%d' % i, 0, 5, 'put', L['id'], 5, '0/i1', t, t, 'echo'))
job = campaign(leases, S, [10, 20], [make_capture(rows)])
t = time.time()
got, err = run(job)
print('2048 leases time', round(time.time() - t, 1), 'error', got.get('error'),
      'bytes', len(json.dumps(got)), file=sys.stderr)
ok &= check('2048 leases count', len(got['snapshots'][0]['leases']), 2048)
ok &= check('2048 services count', len(got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services']), 3)
ok &= check('2048 internal', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][7]['internal'],
            [str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8:0007::/56').network_address) + 1))])
ok &= check('2048 ledger', got['snapshots'][1]['ledger']['live'], 2048)

# lease ids sorted lexically
ids = [l['lease'] for l in got['snapshots'][0]['leases']]
ok &= check('lease order', ids == sorted(ids), True)

# many requests on one target, offers with capacities
L = lease('h', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 1)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'h', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
requests = [request('r%03d' % i, 10, 'h', T1, 'b', 'q') for i in range(300)]
offers = [offer('o%03d' % i, 11, 'b', '2001:db8:1:1200::/64', 1, i % 7, 'q',
                [r['id'] for r in requests[:50]]) for i in range(20)]
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)], requests=requests, offers=offers)
t = time.time()
got, err = run(job)
print('300 requests time', round(time.time() - t, 1), 'resolved', got['plan']['resolved'],
      file=sys.stderr)
ok &= check('300 requests feasible', got['plan']['resolved'] <= 20, True)
kinds = {len(x['send']) for x in got['plan']['assignments']}
ok &= check('adb certificate everywhere', kinds, {1})

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
timeout 300 python3 t11.py
